    The Euler form on projective presentations #

    Call P Euler-projective if ⟨dim P, dim W⟩ = dim Hom(P, W) for every W. The indecomposable projectives Ae are Euler-projective (eulerProj_projE), and so are binary sums of Euler-projectives (EulerProj.prod). For a short exact sequence 0 → P₁ → P₀ → Z → 0 of Euler-projectives, ⟨dim Z, dim W⟩ = dim Hom(Z, W) - dim coker(Hom(P₀, W) → Hom(P₁, W)) (euler_presentation); the cokernel is Ext¹(Z, W) when P₀, P₁ are projective.
